entries.q: How do I rent a house through Traction Properties?
entries.a: Reach out through the WhatsApp link on this page with your budget, preferred location, and number of bedrooms. Our team will share matching listings, arrange a viewing, and guide you through the tenancy agreement and move-in process.

entries.q: Are the rental listings on this page the full list?
entries.a: No, this page shows a sample of available homes. Our full inventory changes frequently, so contact us directly for the most current list of houses for rent in Abuja.

entries.q: Does Traction Properties verify landlords before listing a rental?
entries.a: Yes. We verify property ownership and documentation before a home is listed for rent, and we manage the tenancy agreement so both tenant and landlord are protected.

entries.q: What areas of Abuja do you have rentals in?
entries.a: We manage and broker rentals across Abuja, including areas such as Kado, Mabushi, and Wuse. Contact us with your preferred location and we will match you with available homes.

entries.q: What does the property ID on a listing mean?
entries.a: Every fully verified listing — one with confirmed photos, price, and location — carries a unique property ID badge, such as 104AB. You can search for a specific listing by typing its ID into the search box above the listings. Listings still being finalized do not yet have an ID.
